name: @actualwave/react-native-swc
description: On-device SWC (Rust) transformer for React Native: TypeScript, JSX, ES module and ES5 lowering with source maps. Optional companion to @actualwave/react-native-hermes-eval.

scripts.build: npm run build:android -- arm64-v8a armeabi-v7a x86_64
